text: CDC reports the DRC Ebola outbreak has topped 9,235 confirmed cases (Oct 17). Kenya confirmed a third Bundibugyo case on Oct 16, linked to the first patient; the second, on Oct 15, was a quarantined relative of that patient.

judge.comment: Figures and attribution match the tracker events dated Oct 15-17. Tracker KPI cards use a different, older count, so the headline figure is attributed to the CDC.

factChecks.claim: DRC Ebola outbreak tops 9,235 confirmed cases, CDC reports
Kenya third Bundibugyo case on Oct 16, linked to first patient
Second Kenya case on Oct 15 was a quarantined relative of the first

text: Ship attacks in the Strait of Hormuz hit a weekly record as oil flows slow again (Oct 17). Iran says tankers were struck by mines; the IRGC says it struck a vessel. Two ships were reportedly sunk on Oct 15.

judge.comment: Claims are attributed and match tracker event headlines; no unsourced figures. The sinking is described as reported, not confirmed.

factChecks.claim: Ship attacks in Hormuz hit weekly record, oil flows slow again
Iran says tankers hit by mines; IRGC says it struck a vessel

text: Los CDC reportan que el brote de ébola en la RDC superó los 9.235 casos confirmados (17 oct). Kenia confirmó el 16 oct un tercer caso de Bundibugyo, vinculado al primer paciente; el segundo, del 15 oct, fue un familiar en cuarentena de ese paciente.

judge.comment: Spanish translation of the English Ebola tweet; same figures and attribution.

factChecks.claim: DRC outbreak tops 9,235 confirmed cases per CDC
Kenya third case Oct 16 linked to first patient
Second Kenya case Oct 15 was a quarantined relative

text: How much Russian refining capacity is disabled? Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% (Jul 2026). IEA: losses 'more than 20%' at peak. Reuters analysis: national oil processing fell only 3-6%, as undamaged refineries partly offset the losses.

judge.comment: Presents three sourced positions without adjudicating. Figures come from the tracker's unresolved-dispute entry; contested type needs human review.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were more than 20% at peak
Reuters reported national processing fell only 3-6%

text: How many Yemeni government troops died in the Aug 6 Marib/Hadramout offensive? Government: at least 30 killed. An AFP military source: possibly 58. The Houthis claimed 45 killed. Three counts, three sources.

judge.comment: States each side with attribution and does not adjudicate. Sourced from the tracker's unresolved-dispute and frozen-figure entries.

factChecks.claim: Government confirmed at least 30 soldiers killed
AFP military source said toll may have reached 58
